notes: Modular broadcast server: EVS states "over 370 validated I/O configurations," so the exact video-module population and total SDI/SFP port count vary per order. Physical I/O above was read directly from the labeled rear-panel photo in EVS's own XT-VIA datasheet (evs.com), cross-checked against the datasheet's text spec table (SDI I/O, IP I/O, Audio, Multi-network, and dimensions sections). The photographed reference unit has 7 populated hot-swap video I/O module bays (out of 8 possible, per the "MONITORING – MODULE 1-8" bus) arranged as 6 in three stacked rows plus 1 more beside the MADI module; only one representative module's 6 ports (SDI IN A/OUT A/IN B/OUT B + SFP C/D) is listed here — multiply by the number of installed modules (up to 8) for a specific real system. SDI grade (1.5G/3G/12G) is software-selectable per the datasheet; shown at the maximum (12G). No dedicated EVS "XT-VIA hardware/technical reference manual" with a formal connector table could be located publicly (unlike older XT/XT-3/XS models), so port labels come from OCR-quality reading of a marketing photo rather than an installation manual — some small/blurry module-number silkscreens (module 7 vs 8, exact XNet trademark text) could not be fully confirmed. Two connector types have no exact match in the allowed id list and were mapped to the closest available: the 15-pin D-sub AES/EBU audio breakout connectors (Digital Audio In/Out) were mapped to "vga" (closest D-sub shell, NOT actual VGA video), and the 25-pin D-sub GPI parallel contact-closure connector was mapped to "rs232" (closest D-sub control connector, NOT RS232 protocol). Rack height (6U) is derived from the datasheet's stated 270 mm case height. Manufacturer's general product page: https://evs.com/products/live-production-servers/xt-via.

ports.name: SDI IN A (video I/O module)
ports.note: One of 6 BNCs on a hot-swap video I/O module; software-selectable 1.5G/3G/12G-SDI. Chassis has up to 8 identical module bays (this reference unit's photographed rear panel has 7 populated).

ports.name: SFP C (video I/O module)
ports.note: Hybrid IP alternative to SDI IN/OUT A on the same module; used for SMPTE ST2110/2022-6 video.

ports.name: SFP D (video I/O module)
ports.note: Hybrid IP alternative to SDI IN/OUT B.

ports.name: Monitoring – Module 1
ports.note: Fixed monitor/preview BNC bus at top of rear panel, one tap per module bay (labeled MODULE 1-8 on the panel, present regardless of which bays are populated).

ports.name: XNet-VIA A1
ports.note: EVS XNet-VIA 10Gbps Ethernet-IP media-sharing network, redundant A/B paths x2 ports each.

ports.name: MADI I1
ports.note: MADI (AES10) over 75-ohm BNC coax, labeled MADI (AES3) on the panel.

ports.name: Digital Audio In 1-8
ports.note: Physically a 15-pin D-sub breakout for 8 AES channel pairs; no exact D-sub-15 id exists in the palette, mapped to the closest (VGA/DE-15 shell) — NOT a video VGA port.

ports.name: Digital Audio In 9-16
ports.note: Same connector type as Digital Audio In 1-8.

ports.name: Digital Audio Out 1-8
ports.note: 15-pin D-sub AES output breakout; mapped to closest available id (see Digital Audio In note).

ports.name: GPI
ports.note: Physically a 25-pin D-sub parallel contact-closure GPI interface, not RS232 serial; no DB25/GPI id exists in the palette so RS232 was chosen as the closest D-sub control connector.

ports.name: XNet IN
ports.note: Legacy EVS XNet media-sharing network, 3G-SDTI over BNC coax (per datasheet: EVS XNet (3G-SDTI)).

ports.name: 1GbE-1
ports.note: Companion port for the SFP+ IP-video network card.

ports.name: SFP+ 1
ports.note: 10G Ethernet SFP+ for ST2110/2022-6/2022-7 IP video I/O, per datasheet IP I/O spec.

ports.name: AC In 1 (PSU 1)
ports.note: Hot-swap redundant PSU, universal 100-240VAC per rear nameplate (115-240VAC ±10%).
